The service has classic social media app features, such as leaving likes, comments and sharing the posts of others. Moreover, it’s all about establishing valuable relationships with other players and professionals by following them and staying in touch.

The purpose of the app is clear - integrating the whole football community within the same digital ecosystem. Uploading videos is just a start for a bigger career and development. By providing our users wide access to specialist know-how, multiple coaches, nutritionists, psychologists and athletes, we want to help shape their athletic future. Such a community gives the opportunity to get noticed by football academies and scouts around the world.

Get creative and show us what you can do - from showing your skills on a pitch and demonstrating your best moves to creating challenges and inviting other users to join.
